title.mg: Fitambaran'ny isa roa azo zaraina amin'ny 2

statement.fr: Soient $a$ et $b$ deux entiers naturels pairs. Montrer que $a+b$ est pair.
statement.mg: Isa natoraly azo zaraina amin'ny 2 ny $a$ sy $b$. Porofoy fa azo zaraina amin'ny 2 koa ny $a+b$.
statement.en: Let $a$ and $b$ be even natural numbers. Show that $a+b$ is even.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_pair_somme (a b : ℕ) (ha : Even a) (hb : Even b) : Even (a + b) := by sorry

hints.mg: Inona no dikan'ny hoe azo zaraina amin'ny 2?

exercises.solution:
obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha
obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hb
exact ⟨x + y, by omega⟩

exercises.lean: theorem ex_carre_somme (a b : ℝ) : (a + b) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b + b ^ 2 := by sorry

statement.en: Show that $x^2-2x+1\ge 0$ for every real $x$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_trinome_positif (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 - 2 * x + 1 := by sorry

exercises.lean: theorem ex_equation_affine (x : ℝ) (h : 3 * x + 5 = 11) : x = 2 := by sorry

statement.fr: Montrer que $2ab\le a^2+b^2$ pour tous réels $a,b$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa $2ab\le a^2+b^2$ ho an'ny réel $a,b$ rehetra.
statement.en: Show that $2ab\le a^2+b^2$ for all real $a,b$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_moyennes (a b : ℝ) : 2 * a * b ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by sorry

statement.fr: Montrer que $n(n+1)$ est pair pour tout entier naturel $n$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa azo zaraina amin'ny 2 ny $n(n+1)$ ho an'ny isa natoraly $n$ rehetra.
statement.en: Show that $n(n+1)$ is even for every natural number $n$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_produit_consecutifs (n : ℕ) : Even (n * (n + 1)) := by sorry

hints.fr: L'un des deux facteurs est pair.
hints.mg: Misy iray azo zaraina amin'ny 2 amin'ireo.
hints.en: One of the two factors is even.

hints.mg: Saraho: azo zaraina amin'ny 2 ny $n$, na tsia.

title.mg: Fitambaran'ny isa tsy azo zaraina amin'ny 2

statement.fr: Montrer par récurrence que $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(2i+1)=n^2$.
statement.mg: Porofoy amin'ny récurrence fa $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(2i+1)=n^2$.
statement.en: Show by induction that $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(2i+1)=n^2$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_somme_impairs (n : ℕ) : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2 := by sorry

hints.fr: Isolez le dernier terme de la somme.
hints.mg: Saraho ny singa farany amin'ny fitambarana.

exercises.solution:
induction n with
| zero => simp
| succ k ih =>
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
  ring

statement.fr: Montrer que $2\sum_{i=0}^{n} i=n(n+1)$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa $2\sum_{i=0}^{n} i=n(n+1)$.
statement.en: Show that $2\sum_{i=0}^{n} i=n(n+1)$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_somme_entiers (n : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), i = n * (n + 1) := by sorry
exercises.solution:
induction n with
| zero => simp
| succ k ih =>
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih]
  ring

statement.fr: Montrer que la composée de deux fonctions injectives est injective.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa injective ny composée an'ny fonction injective roa.
statement.en: Show that the composition of two injective functions is injective.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_composee_injective {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) : Function.Injective (g ∘ f) := by sorry

hints.mg: Ampiasao aloha ny maha injective ny $g$.

exercises.solution:
intro a b h
exact hf (hg h)

statement.fr: Montrer que $A\cap(B\cup C)=(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap C)$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa $A\cap(B\cup C)=(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap C)$.
statement.en: Show that $A\cap(B\cup C)=(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap C)$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_distributivite {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) := by sorry
exercises.solution:
ext x
simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_union]
tauto

statement.fr: Soit $G$ un groupe tel que $g^2=1$ pour tout $g$. Montrer que $G$ est commutatif.
statement.mg: Groupe ny $G$ ary $g^2=1$ ho an'ny $g$ rehetra. Porofoy fa commutatif ny $G$.
statement.en: Let $G$ be a group with $g^2=1$ for all $g$. Show that $G$ is commutative.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_groupe_involutions {G : Type*} [Group G] (h : ∀ g : G, g * g = 1) (a b : G) : a * b = b * a := by sorry
exercises.solution:
have h1 : ∀ g : G, g⁻¹ = g := fun g => by
  rw [inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one]
  exact h g
calc a * b = (a * b)⁻¹ := (h1 _).symm
  _ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := mul_inv_rev a b
  _ = b * a := by rw [h1, h1]

exercises.lean: theorem ex_continue_polynome : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 + 1) := by sorry

statement.mg: Porofoy fa injective ny application linéaire raha aotra ny noyau, ary raha izany ihany.
statement.en: Show that a linear map is injective if and only if its kernel is zero.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_noyau_injectif {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (f : V →ₗ[K] W) : LinearMap.ker f = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f := by sorry

hints.mg: Mitovy dika ny $f(x)=f(y)$ sy ny $x-y\in\ker f$.

statement.fr: Montrer que $6$ divise $n^3-n$ pour tout entier $n$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa azo zaraina amin'ny 6 ny $n^3-n$ ho an'ny entier $n$ rehetra.
statement.en: Show that $6$ divides $n^3-n$ for every integer $n$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_cube_moins_n (n : ℤ) : 6 ∣ n ^ 3 - n := by sorry
exercises.solution:
have h : n % 6 = 0 ∨ n % 6 = 1 ∨ n % 6 = 2 ∨ n % 6 = 3 ∨ n % 6 = 4 ∨ n % 6 = 5 := by omega
apply Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero
rcases h with h | h | h | h | h | h <;> simp [pow_succ, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, h]

statement.fr: Montrer que le reste de $n^2$ dans la division par $4$ est $0$ ou $1$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa $0$ na $1$ ny ambiny rehefa zaraina amin'ny $4$ ny $n^2$.
statement.en: Show that $n^2$ leaves remainder $0$ or $1$ when divided by $4$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_carre_mod_quatre (n : ℤ) : n ^ 2 % 4 = 0 ∨ n ^ 2 % 4 = 1 := by sorry

hints.fr: Distinguez les restes possibles de $n$ modulo $4$.
hints.mg: Saraho ny ambiny mety ho azo amin'ny $n$ modulo $4$.
hints.en: Split on the remainder of $n$ modulo $4$.

exercises.solution:
have h : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by omega
rcases h with h | h | h | h <;> simp [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, h]

statement.fr: Soient $a,b>0$ réels. Montrer que $(a+b)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b\right)\ge 4$.
statement.mg: Réel ny $a,b>0$. Porofoy fa $(a+b)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b\right)\ge 4$.
statement.en: Let $a,b>0$ be real. Show that $(a+b)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b\right)\ge 4$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_somme_inverses (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 4 ≤ (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) := by sorry
exercises.solution:
have h : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) - 4 = (a - b) ^ 2 / (a * b) := by
  field_simp
  ring
have h2 : 0 ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 / (a * b) := by positivity
linarith

statement.fr: Montrer que $7$ divise $2^{3n}-1$ pour tout entier naturel $n$.
statement.mg: Porofoy fa azo zaraina amin'ny 7 ny $2^{3n}-1$ ho an'ny isa natoraly $n$ rehetra.
statement.en: Show that $7$ divides $2^{3n}-1$ for every natural number $n$.

exercises.lean: theorem ex_puissance_sept (n : ℕ) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ (3 * n) - 1 := by sorry
exercises.solution:
have h : 2 ^ (3 * n) = 8 ^ n := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
rw [h]
simpa using nat_sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow 8 1 n
